robinson.name: Liste Robinson (SDV)
robinson.notes: Stops cold addressed paper mail from SDV members. Not a digital or credit wipe. File first. Live recipe 2026-08-19: Gravity Forms + WP Armour — send alt_s empty, honey field fresh from the page.

youronlinechoices.name: YourOnlineChoices (EDAA)
youronlinechoices.notes: Digital ads one-shot for CH. Complements Robinson (paper). Not erasure of broker files.

localsearch.name: local.ch / search.ch
localsearch.notes: Swiss phone book. Form first; nLPD letter to dataprivacy@ if the form blocks. Blind email even when scan is not_found.

moneyhouse.name: Moneyhouse
moneyhouse.notes: People + company search. nLPD opposition by email. Company register copies stay. /fr/deletion was 404 on 2026-08-19.

poste.name: La Poste
poste.human_extra: Yellow Stop Pub sticker on the letterbox — human, 30 seconds.
poste.notes: Digital unsubscribe for addressed mailings. Sticker is human.

kbdirect.name: KünzlerBachmann Directmarketing
kbdirect.notes: Swiss address / marketing-data house; localsearch names them as a contract partner. nLPD letter.

intrum.name: Intrum AG
intrum.notes: nLPD opposition to marketing / onward sale. Payment-collection rows may stay. Not a full credit wipe.

google_results.name: Google — results about you
google_results.notes: Delist personal contact info from Search. What landlords and colleagues actually see.

criteo.name: Criteo
criteo.notes: EU-established adtech that profiles Swiss users. Rights form or DPO email (nLPD + GDPR).

acxiom.name: Acxiom
acxiom.notes: Global broker with a consumer rights portal. Blind opt-out.

dnb.name: Dun & Bradstreet CH
dnb.notes: Only if a person/director page is found. Company pages stay. Inconclusive search → blocked, not not_found.

crif.name: CRIF AG
crif.notes: Main Swiss credit file. Official ID required. Digest only.

az_direct.name: AZ Direct AG
az_direct.notes: Largest Swiss address trader. Sperrung + ID. Digest only. Prefer block over delete.
